{{Quote|We've just lost the ''Unity''! The heavy turbolasers on those frigates are tearing through our shields. Take them out before we lose any more ships!|Admiral Yularen to a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi pilot]] at the Battle of Dorin|<ref name="cwa">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
Built by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], the '''''Unity''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a large [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]&mdash;under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]&mdash;[[Battle of Dorin|invaded]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] aligned-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]]. The ''Unity'' was part of a Republic task force led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] that was dispatched to Dorin to beat back the Separatist attack. The two fleets engaged in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] above Dorin, trading [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire and launching [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. However, the ''Unity'' was overwhelmed by the bombardment unleashed by the Separatist [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], which destroyed the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]].

==Description==
The ''Unity'' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that was part of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Starfighter" /> Manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], the ''Unity'' was 1,137 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long,<ref name="Databank" /> and was equipped with eight [[Engine/Legends|engines]], a [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivator]], and a pair of [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|command towers]].<ref name="Starfighter" /> The ''Unity'' had an armament of fifty-two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], eight [[DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret/Legends|DBY-827 heavy dual turbolaser turrets]], two medium dual [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons, four [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]] tubes, and six [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors.<ref name="Databank" /> The [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was also equipped with [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], but these would collapse under sustained enemy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] fire.<ref name="Starfighter" />

==History==
{{Quote|Intelligence has reported a large Republic fleet leaving orbit around Coruscant. It seems the planet Dorin is finally going to receive reinforcements to counter your attack.|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and General Grievous|<ref name="Prelude to Point Rain" />}}
[[File:BattleofDorin-CWA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The ''Unity'' is destroyed during the Battle of Dorin]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="swannual" /> a large Confederate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]&mdash;under the command of [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]&mdash;launched an [[Battle of Dorin|invasion]] on the Republic aligned-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Separatist fleet&mdash;composed of [[Grievous's Separatist frigate|Grievous's command frigate]],<ref name="Prelude to Point Rain">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091103fd/index.html|text=Fan Days Script: A Prelude to "Point Rain"}}</ref> two [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ships]], and sixteen [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]]<ref name="Starfighter" />&mdash;began to lay waste to Dorin, [[Death/Legends|killing]] many Kel Dor loyal to the Republic.<ref name="Prelude to Point Rain" />

When the Republic received word of the Separatist attack, they formed a task force to reinforce Dorin. Led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], the task force included the ''Unity'', Skywalker's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], and seven other ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers.<ref name="Starfighter" /> The ''Unity'' and the rest of the Republic fleet soon departed from the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, the fleet's movement was discovered by Separatist intelligence, which informed Grievous of the incoming Republic [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]]. In preparation for the upcoming battle, Grievous recalled his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] from Dorin's surface and prepared his fleet and [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] for combat.<ref name="Prelude to Point Rain" />

The ''Unity'' and the rest of the Republic task force jumped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] over Dorin and engaged Grievous's forces in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] above the planet. Both fleets began launching [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and trading turbolaser strikes with each other. However, the ''Unity''{{'s}} deflector shields, under concentrated fire from the Confederacy's [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]]' heavy turbolasers, failed, causing the ''Unity'' to break apart in space.<ref name="Starfighter" />

Despite the loss of the ''Unity'', the Republic flotilla managed to defeat Grievous's forces, causing the Confederate General to flee the battle and freeing Dorin from the Separatists.<ref name="Starfighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Unity'' was first indirectly mentioned in a script reading by the main characters of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series voice-acting cast at the [[October]] 2009 ''Star Wars'' Fan Days III convention. In the script reading, the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] reports to General Grievous the Republic fleet's&mdash;and therefore the ''Unity''{{'s}}&mdash;departure from Coruscant.<ref name="Prelude to Point Rain" /> The ''Unity'' later appeared in the "Starfighter" mini-game of the [[2010]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' video game]], in which the Star Destroyer was destroyed midway through the Battle of Dorin.
